name: repx
description: RepX — the Chess.com of fitness. Competitive, AI-verified bodyweight exercise matches.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @repx/shared && npm run db:setup -w @repx/backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @repx/backend" "npm run dev -w @repx/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @repx/shared && npm run build -w @repx/backend && npm run build -w @repx/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @repx/shared && npm run typecheck -w @repx/backend && npm run typecheck -w @repx/frontend

//test.note: `npm test` is offline: exercise-engine and ELO regression tests in shared/. `npm run test:e2e` drives two real Socket.IO clients through a full match and needs the API running (npm run dev:backend). Frontend component tests are still outstanding — see docs/TESTING.md.

//allowScripts: npm 11 blocks install scripts by default. These three genuinely need them: Prisma downloads/generates its query engine, esbuild installs its platform binary for Vite.
